entities.title: window.chessBridge
entities.summary: The JavaScript object the Godot game calls through JavaScriptBridge.get_interface("chessBridge").
guarantees: baseUrl() is the game's address, ending in /
returnPath() is this page's path, with ?challenge=ID while an invitation in the address has not been taken
takeChallenge() returns the invitation id from the address once, then removes it from the address
bestMove(moves, level, done) calls done with one UCI move, or with "" when the engine fails; a cancelled search never calls back
cancelEngine() stops any search; preloadEngine() starts the engine early
navigate(url), setTitle(text) and copy(text) leave the page, set the tab's title and copy to the clipboard
entities.compatibility: bridge.js and the Godot export are built and deployed together, so the two sides change in the same commit; a renamed or removed call breaks the game in the browser only, since the desktop build never calls it.

entities.title: The page's elements
entities.summary: The ids bridge.js needs in the shell page: godot-config, status, bar-fill and notice.
consumers: godot/web_shell/shell.html, the page the export produces
guarantees: #godot-config holds Godot's export config as JSON
#status is the loading screen; bridge.js adds done when the game starts and failed when it cannot
#bar-fill's width shows the download's progress; #notice shows why the game could not start
bridge.js is loaded after Godot's loader, which defines the global Engine
entities.compatibility: shell.html, shell.css and bridge/main.ts change together.
